review.assessment:
This change introduces only `worksched/holidays.py`. Because the diff does not show any modifications to the scheduler's core logic or imports, I cannot verify how this module is integrated into the broader tree, nor can I confirm whether other files rely on this lookup. The task scope requires that every printed date be an open day; without seeing the caller, I am limited to auditing the logic inside this new file itself.

The diff adds a holiday dictionary keyed by calendar year and two utility functions. However, the `for_year` function intentionally queries the table using `year - 1`, which retrieves the previous year's holidays instead of the requested calendar year. This directly contradicts both the internal docstring warning about re-keying and the task description noting that the lookup is already 'a year off'.
